summary: Made plain `sync` (no --resources flag) populate the local store by default.
reason: defaultSyncResources() returned an empty slice even though "schema" is a registered syncable resource (knownSyncResourceNames() already includes it), making `sync` a silent no-op unless the user knew to pass --resources schema explicitly. Dogfood flagged this as a structural gap: store-dependent novel commands had no advertised default population path.
validated_outcome: dogfood --live confirmed PASS after the fix; `sync` with no flags now populates the local store from /schema.
